project: Wuxia Life P20 Replayability And Archetype Coverage Optimization
description: Improve wuxia-life replayability after P16-P19 by auditing current archetype coverage, defining explicit replayability and pacing rules, extending profile-first configuration surfaces for archetype differentiation and repetition control, wiring those surfaces through minimal theme-neutral runtime support, shipping representative replay slices, and proving the results with regression and closure reports without adding UI work, new themes, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit observable archetype coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current wuxia archetype coverage so that P20 targets meaningful emergence gaps instead of broad undirected expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit currently observable archetypes across origin, growth pattern, route identity, social role, legacy shape, and endgame memory
Mark each archetype family as strongly supported, weakly supported, or effectively missing
Record the main reasons weak or missing archetypes fail to emerge
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit repeated-run overlap baseline
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of repeated-run overlap so that P20 can reduce the highest-value repetition failures first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit repeated-run overlap across high-frequency events, repeated stage rhythms, and repeated payoff shapes
Record where different setup candidates collapse into materially similar event or payoff sequences
Identify whether the main repetition drivers come from config gaps, over-dominant routes, pool scarcity, or spacing collapse
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit whole-life pacing baseline
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of whole-life pacing so that P20 can tune the real density and payoff problems instead of guessing from summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit stage density, route-pressure timing, payoff spacing, callback cadence, and endgame closure rhythm across representative runs
Record where childhood, youth, adulthood, late life, or endgame currently feel too empty, too dense, or too homogeneous
Identify where pacing collapse causes otherwise different archetype candidates to reconverge
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write representative archetype family rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit representative archetype families so that later P20 implementation stories target a coherent first replayability coverage set.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the 3-5 representative archetype families in scope for the first P20 pass
Define which lifecycle inputs should materially distinguish each archetype family
Record which archetype families or variants are explicitly deferred beyond P20
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write repetition-control and recurrence rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for harmful repetition versus healthy thematic recurrence so that P20 freshness tuning does not break wuxia continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what counts as harmful repetition across events, rhythm, payoff, and late-life closure
Define how exact-repeat suppression, novelty preference, and thematic continuity should trade off in the first P20 pass
Record which replayability problems are explicitly deferred beyond P20
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write whole-life pacing differentiation rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit pacing-differentiation rules so that materially different archetypes do not converge into the same full-life rhythm.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how stage density, route-pressure timing, payoff spacing, callback cadence, and endgame closure distribution should differ across representative archetypes
Define which pacing differences must be visible in reports or debug output versus which may remain implicit in weighting
Record the P20 non-goals for UI work, new themes, and large runtime rewrites in implementation-facing terms
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/
